text: The data breach described has a severe impact due to the highly sensitive nature of the compromised information. The unauthorized access involved patient names, health insurance details, medical histories, and treatment information. This combination of personally identifiable information (PII) and protected health information (PHI) creates significant risks for the 200,000 affected individuals. Specifically, the exposure of health insurance details and medical histories facilitates both identity theft and insurance fraud, as malicious actors can exploit this data to assume identities, file false claims, or engage in other financial crimes. The breach thus poses substantial financial, legal, and privacy consequences for the patients involved.
